notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Activate Shigeki's channel ability by paying {4}{G}{G} and discarding it, returning Turnabout and Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, returning Shigeki to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
